text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Aaaah, so cool...! Good grief, to think 
both of us would end up crashing in your 
room..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped. You couldn't have 
predicted the AC suddenly breaking down, 
right? Make yourself at home.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! And if you consider that this 
trick of fate guided you to my stage, 
isn't it rather fortunate?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, this one's noisy as ever today... Hm? 
Come to think of it, where'd Dotou go?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
P-Please don't mind me...! I'm sorry, I'm 
so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...! Doto-kun, why are you under 
the bed?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I was just trying to take up as little 
space as possible...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Geez, pullin' that gloomy crap again...! 
Look at the floor space, there's barely 
any difference, so get your butt out here!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeek! B-But still... Wouldn't I be in 
the way after all...?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! How delightfully amusing! 
Why, it's just like Amaterasu hiding away 
in the Heavenly Rock Cave!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I have no choice but to put on a 
fun banquet to lure them out! La la la~♪ 
The crowing rooster dances with the 
Conqueror~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Shut up!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mm... Given her personality, it would be 
difficult to move her heart through logic 
or curiosity. We should appeal to a more 
primal desire.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...And so, Doto-kun. I happen to have a 
delicious frozen banana here...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No way, you won't lure me in with food 
either!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ......Ah jeez, dammit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Doto, I'll pay you back later, go 
buy cold drinks for four from the shop."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes～! I'll be right there～!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's block off under the bed 
while we still can!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, Opera O-san gets the rose ice cream... 
Hayahide-san gets the banana juice...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Four portions means there's one 
for me too...? Auugh, Shakur-san...
